tokens.name: background-primary
tokens.usage: Pleos background/primary (dark: basic/900). Screen background behind every card.

tokens.name: background-secondary
tokens.usage: Pleos background/secondary (dark: Surface/container). Card and popup surface.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Pleos text/dark/primary (dark: text/light/primary). Titles, values and body copy on background-primary and background-secondary; 17:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Pleos text/*/secondary. Supporting copy on either background; 10:1 or better.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Pleos text/*/tertiary. Labels, units and captions ("최근 랩", "km/h"); 5.4:1 light, 7.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: text-quaternary
tokens.usage: Pleos text/*/quaternary. Disabled text and unselected gears only: 2.1:1 light, 2.9:1 dark, so never for information that must be read.

tokens.name: icon-primary
tokens.usage: Pleos icon/dark/primary (dark: icon/light/primary). Default fill for system icons.

tokens.name: divider-primary
tokens.usage: Pleos divider/primary. Faintest separator, inside cards on background-secondary.

tokens.name: divider-secondary
tokens.usage: Pleos divider/secondary. Row dividers in lap and list cards; disabled button border.

tokens.name: divider-tertiary
tokens.usage: Pleos divider/tertiary. Page-navigation bottom border and vertical title dividers.

tokens.name: button-basic-enabled
tokens.usage: Pleos button/basic/enabled (dark: alpha/light/100). Primary (basic) button and icon button fill.

tokens.name: button-basic-pressed
tokens.usage: Pleos button/basic/pressed (dark: alpha/light/200). Pressed state of basic buttons.

tokens.name: button-filled-enabled
tokens.usage: Pleos button/filled/enabled (dark: keyboard/static/primary_normal). Secondary (filled) button; carries on-filled text.

tokens.name: button-filled-pressed
tokens.usage: Pleos button/filled/pressed (dark: keyboard/static/primary_pressed). Pressed filled button.

tokens.name: on-filled
tokens.usage: Text and icons on button-filled-*: 9.4:1 light, 5.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Pleos basic/100 (dark: basic/700). Empty part of bars, gauges, unlit shift-light segments and tyre tiles.

tokens.name: overlay-default
tokens.usage: Pleos overlay/default (dark: alpha/dark/400). Scrim behind popups.

tokens.name: basic-00
tokens.usage: Pleos basic/00. Raw palette; prefer the semantic tokens above.

tokens.name: basic-50
tokens.usage: Pleos basic/50. Raw palette.

tokens.name: basic-100
tokens.usage: Pleos basic/100. Raw palette.

tokens.name: basic-200
tokens.usage: Pleos basic/200. Raw palette; unlit telltale tint in the app.

tokens.name: basic-300
tokens.usage: Pleos basic/300. Raw palette.

tokens.name: basic-400
tokens.usage: Pleos basic/400. Raw palette.

tokens.name: basic-500
tokens.usage: Pleos basic/500. Raw palette.

tokens.name: basic-600
tokens.usage: Pleos basic/600. Raw palette.

tokens.name: basic-700
tokens.usage: Pleos basic/700. Raw palette.

tokens.name: basic-800
tokens.usage: Pleos basic/800. Raw palette.

tokens.name: basic-900
tokens.usage: Pleos basic/900. Raw palette.

tokens.name: ac-accent
tokens.usage: App accent, from Pleos Feature/Media/music-primary. Driver input and position: throttle bar, car marker on the track map, shift-light first stage, media progress, edit-mode outlines. 3.6:1 on white, 4.6:1 on dark surface: bars, icons and bold text 19px+ only, never small text.

tokens.name: ac-brake
tokens.usage: From Pleos Button/Call/end-normal. Limits: brake bar, redline zone and tick labels, shift-light last stage, overheated tyres, a lap slower than best. 3.6:1 on white: marks and bold text 19px+ only.

tokens.name: ac-telltale
tokens.usage: Amber of the Pleos driving-view telltales (TCS, ABS). An assist is intervening; shift-light middle stage. Pleos source value: 2.4:1 on white, so it only ever appears as an icon or segment paired with a shape, never as text.

tokens.name: ac-ok
tokens.usage: From Pleos Miscellaneous/Switch/background-on. Connected status dot and personal-best delta. Pleos source value: 2.4:1 on white, so use it as a dot or bar beside a word, never as the only signal.

tokens.name: ac-fastest
tokens.usage: From Pleos Feature/Media/radio-primary. Motorsport timing purple: session-best lap or sector. 4.2:1 on white, 3.7:1 on dark surface.

tokens.name: ac-cold
tokens.usage: Tint of ac-accent. Tyre tile background below the working window (under 75 °C).

tokens.name: ac-hot
tokens.usage: Tint of ac-brake. Tyre tile background above the working window (over 100 °C); redline arc track.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an ac-accent fill: 3.6:1, so bold 19px+ only. Smaller text on ac-accent uses text-primary on light (5.1:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and rotary focus: solid 3px ring, 3:1 or better on both backgrounds.

tokens.name: shift-stage-1
tokens.usage: Shift light, first 40% of segments (approaching the shift point).

tokens.name: shift-stage-2
tokens.usage: Shift light, middle 40% of segments.

tokens.name: shift-stage-3
tokens.usage: Shift light, last 20% of segments and the whole strip flashing at the shift point.

tokens.name: static-light-100
tokens.usage: Pleos static/light/100. Title and transport glyphs on the music card's album-art ground (MusicPlayer), the same in both themes.

tokens.name: static-light-200
tokens.usage: Pleos static/light/200. Artist line and progress fill on the album-art ground.

tokens.name: static-light-300
tokens.usage: Pleos static/light/300. Elapsed and remaining time on the album-art ground.

tokens.name: static-light-400
tokens.usage: Pleos static/light/400. Placeholder note icon when there is no album art.

tokens.name: alpha-light-100
tokens.usage: Pleos alpha/light/100. Album-art placeholder tile on the music ground.

tokens.name: alpha-light-200
tokens.usage: Pleos alpha/light/200. Progress track, pressed glyph and the "on" circle behind shuffle and repeat.

tokens.name: alpha-dark-300
tokens.usage: Pleos alpha/dark/300. Left end of the scrim laid over the blurred album art.

tokens.name: alpha-dark-500
tokens.usage: Pleos alpha/dark/500. Right end of the scrim, behind the title and controls, so static-light text stays readable on bright art.

styles.name: title-medium
styles.usage: Pleos Title/Medium/Strong. Now-playing title, fuel value.

styles.name: body-large
styles.usage: Pleos Body/Large/Strong. Card values: last and best lap, tyre temperatures.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Pleos Body/Small/Strong. Card titles and small button labels.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: Pleos Label/Medium. Row labels, session line, connection status.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Pleos Label/Small. Smallest text allowed (Pleos guide: 18-20px minimum height). Pedal captions, units.

styles.name: driving-speed
styles.usage: Pleos Driving/Speed_kmh. Speed in the gauge centre and the running lap time; tabular figures.

styles.name: list-number
styles.usage: Pleos Gleo AI/List_Number. Lap count badge.

tokens.name: spacing-03
tokens.usage: Pleos Spacing/spacing-03. Gap between paired values, tyre tiles.

tokens.name: spacing-04
tokens.usage: Pleos Spacing/spacing-04. Gap between buttons in a row, icon to label.

tokens.name: spacing-05
tokens.usage: Pleos Spacing/spacing-05. Gap between dashboard cards (the grid gap).

tokens.name: spacing-07
tokens.usage: Pleos Spacing/spacing-07. Card padding.

tokens.name: screen-padding
tokens.usage: App. Outer padding of the app window, and padding of dense cards (cluster, edit-mode handles).

tokens.name: radius-button-small
tokens.usage: Pleos buttons/basic/small radius (64px tall buttons).

tokens.name: radius-icon-button
tokens.usage: Pleos buttons/icon/medium radius (80px icon buttons); app icon tiles and album art.

tokens.name: radius-button-medium
tokens.usage: Pleos buttons/basic/medium radius (80px tall buttons).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Pleos buttons/basic/large radius, used by the app for every dashboard card.

tokens.name: radius-badge
tokens.usage: App. Lap-count badge and small chips.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pleos circle radius. Level bars, status dots, circle icon buttons.

tokens.name: size-icon-grid
tokens.usage: Pleos iconography: icons are drawn at 48px on a 24 grid, then scaled.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icon inside an 80px icon button.

tokens.name: size-icon-small
tokens.usage: Icon inside a 64px icon button.

tokens.name: size-button-small
tokens.usage: Pleos basic button Small height; top-bar buttons.

tokens.name: size-button-medium
tokens.usage: Pleos basic button Medium height and icon button Medium size; media controls.

tokens.name: size-button-large
tokens.usage: Pleos basic button Large height.

tokens.name: shadow-level2
tokens.usage: Pleos Shadow/Light/Level2. Dashboard cards and the app icon; the dark value is deepened so cards still lift off basic/900.
